transforms.code:
#The path now, not the value this run started with: runs can finish out of order, and a stale run with no path
	#would leave the selection empty while the breadcrumb shows the asset
	assetPath = self.custom.assetPath
	return system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.asset.getAssets({'assetPath': assetPath or 'None'}), 0)

onChange.script:
#	system.perspective.print('assetSelector custom.assetInfo now selected: %s'%self.custom.assetInfo['assetPath'])
	system.perspective.sendMessage("assetSelectorUpdate", self.custom.assetInfo)
	
	return

transforms.code:
#	system.perspective.print("assetSelector - assetPath binding change")
	params = value['params']
	# followValue: the assetPath param is the selection, even when it's cleared (the form owns the value)
	if params.has_key('followValue') and params['followValue']:
		return params['assetPath'] if params.has_key('assetPath') else None
	if not params.has_key('useSessionValue') or params['useSessionValue']: 
		page = 'designer' if '/' in value['page'] else value['page']
		assetPath = value['sessionCustomProps'][page]['selectors']['assetPath']
		return assetPath
	elif params.has_key('assetPath') and params['assetPath']: return params['assetPath']
	
	return self.custom.assetPath

onChange.script:
# followValue: the tree ignores a path set to nothing, so clear it when the assetPath param is cleared. Only on a
	# change from an asset to none: the tree answers clearSelection with an empty selection, which sets None again
	params = self.params.value
	cleared = currentValue is not None and currentValue.value is None and previousValue is not None and previousValue.value is not None
	if cleared and params.get('followValue'):
		system.perspective.sendMessage('clearSelection', {'selectorId': self.custom.selectorId}, scope='page')
